Allergen practice

Fruit oat wheat biscuits

Gyümölcsös keksz

6 months+ Sound idea 25 min 8 portions

Try the first taste in the morning on a well day. Offer wheat in pasta or bread as well through the week. Once gluten is tolerated, keep offering it a few times a week.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g unsweetened fruit purée (apple or pear; no sugar)
  • 60 g rolled oats (soft biscuit base)
  • 1 tbsp plain wheat flour (a real gluten dose, not a trace)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 160 C.
  2. Mix the fruit purée, oats, and wheat flour into a soft dough.
  3. Drop small thick biscuits on a tray.
  4. Bake until set but still soft, not dry.
  5. Cool and press one to check it squashes before you offer it.

Sound idea

A hard sweet biscuit would miss the point of a soft gluten exposure.

Bake soft biscuits from fruit purée, oats, and a spoon of wheat flour so the gluten dose is real. Add no sugar.
